_about: Public-domain Henri Didon (1840-1900, Dominican preacher) in English for the Word Hoard: The Germans, tr. Raphael Ledos de Beaufort (1884), Science without God, tr. Rosa Corder, Jesus Christ: Our Saviour's Person, Mission, and Spirit, ed. Bernard O'Reilly (2 vols, New York: Appleton, 1891), Belief in the Divinity of Jesus Christ, and The Spiritual Letters of Père Didon, tr. Arthur G. Nash (1906), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

didon-the-germans: The Germans, tr. Raphael Ledos de Beaufort (Edinburgh and London: William Blackwood, MDCCCLXXXIV)
didon-science-without-god: Science without God, tr. Rosa Corder (New York: Thomas Whittaker; no year on the title page)

didon-belief-divinity: Belief in the Divinity of Jesus Christ (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, Trübner; no year on the title page)
didon-spiritual-letters: The Spiritual Letters of Père Didon, tr. Arthur G. Nash (London: Kegan Paul, 1906)
